description: Conversion of loft space involving alterations to existing roofline, including a hip to gable extension, a dormer extension at rear, rooflights to front roofslope
decision_conditions:
Matching Materials - The facing materials used in the development hereby permitted shall match those of the existing building in materials, style, colour, texture and, in the case of brickwork, bonding, coursing and pointing.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
